Use whenever documentation must be reconstructed from the code rather than written alongside a change.

trending.name: documenting-contracts

trending.name: writing-issues

trending.name: writing-postmortems
trending.summary: Use when writing a postmortem, incident report, or root-cause analysis after an outage, a defect that reached users, a data issue, or a near miss - or when turning an incident channel, alert log, or war-room thread into a durable document.
